outcome: Maternal satisfaction with focused ANC service
cohort: 411 pregnant women receiving ANC at public health facilities in the West Shewa Zone, Ethiopia, between September 1 and October 15, 2021
finding: Over half of the pregnant women surveyed were dissatisfied with the ANC services provided, highlighting the need for improvements in institutional quality and patient-provider communication.
mod_finding: Previous mode of delivery was significantly associated with women's satisfaction with focused ANC service.
